hierarchy.note: Top-level Part in large codes (Civillikums, Komerclikums): 'Pirmā daļa', 'Otrā daļa'. Absent in ordinary acts. Not to be confused with pants-level daļa (paragraph).
Primary grouping in most acts. Roman (I, II) in older acts, Arabic (1., 2.) in newer. Normalise to Arabic for eId: chap_1, chap_2. Always titled.
Sub-chapter grouping within nodaļa in large codes only. '1. iedaļa'. Maps to AKN section-as-higher-div, not basic unit.

The fundamental citable unit. Continuous Arabic throughout act, no restart per nodaļa. Cited '5. pants'. Maps to AKN article (Germanic tradition, same as Estonian paragrahv). Insertion: 5¹ → art_51, 5² → art_52.
Subdivisions of pants. Numbered (1), (2). Cited formally 'pirmā daļa' (ordinal). CRITICAL: same word as top-level Part — distinguish by nesting depth and presence of titled heading.
Items within daļa. Numbered 1), 2), 3) (Arabic with closing paren). Cited '1. punkts'.
Sub-items within punkts. Lettered a), b), c).

hcontainers.name: parejasNoteikumi
hcontainers.note: Transitional Provisions — always present, always at end of body before attachments. Contains numbered pants (continuing main body sequence). Detect by heading string 'Pārejas noteikumi'.

hcontainers.name: informativaAtsauce
hcontainers.note: Informational Reference to EU Directives — mandatory in EU transposing acts, appears after Pārejas noteikumi. Contains list of Directives being transposed. Post-2004 only.

constitution.label: Satversme (Constitution)

hierarchy.note: Constitution uses Roman-numbered nodaļas (I–VIII). Map to chapter. chap_1 through chap_8.
§ 1 through § 116, continuous across chapters. The preamble (Preambula) precedes Chapter I and maps to <preamble>.

constitution.note: The Satversme (1922) has a preamble recognised as constitutionally binding by the Satversmes tiesa judgment of 2007. Model as <preamble>. No top-level daļa divisions — chapters go directly to pants.

noteikumi.label: Ministru kabineta noteikumi (Cabinet Regulation)
noteikumi.note: Cabinet Regulations follow the same pants/daļa/punkts pattern as acts. Issued under enabling powers of parent act. Cited by sequential MK number per year: 'Ministru kabineta noteikumi Nr. {N}'.

numbering.note: No sequential act numbers — gazette reference is the formal identifier. Pants insertion uses superscript: 5¹ → art_51, 5² → art_52. Cabinet regulations are numbered sequentially per year: MK noteikumi Nr. {N}.

enacting_formulae.note: Latvian acts have no body-text enacting formula. Adoption/promulgation metadata appears in the document header on Latvijas Vēstnesis / likumi.lv. The body begins directly with the first nodaļa or pants. Do not invent an enacting formula.
Cabinet Regulations have an enabling authority formula citing the parent act and specific pants/daļa/punkts. Maps to <preamble><formula name='enablingAuthority'>.

amendments.note: Likumi.lv provides continuously consolidated versions with amendment history. Each consolidation version maps to a FRBR Expression. Amendment phrasing follows Germanic model: precise textual substitution with full replacement text quoted.

structuring.prompt_additions: Latvian 'pants' maps to AKN article (Germanic tradition, same as German § and Estonian paragrahv). 'Daļa' (of a pants) maps to AKN paragraph — numbered (1), (2). 'Punkts' maps to AKN point — numbered 1), 2). 'Apakšpunkts' maps to AKN indent — lettered a), b). 'Nodaļa' maps to AKN chapter. 'Iedaļa' maps to AKN section (as higher division). Top-level 'Daļa' (Part) in large codes maps to AKN part. CRITICAL: Latvian acts have NO body-text enacting formula — do not invent one. Begin BODY with first CHAPTER or ARTICLE. Terminal block 'Pārejas noteikumi' (Transitional Provisions) must be detected by heading string and wrapped in hcontainer, not treated as a nodaļa. Terminal block 'Informatīvā atsauce' similarly. Pants numbering is continuous throughout and does NOT restart per nodaļa. Insertion numbering: 5¹ → art_51, 5² → art_52.

supranational_memberships.note: EU member since 1 May 2004. Regulations directly effective. Directives require Latvian transposing legislation. Transposing acts include mandatory 'Informatīvā atsauce uz Eiropas Savienības direktīvām' block. Use eu/ profile for EU instruments; link transposing lv/ acts to their Directive via <references>.
Council of Europe member since 10 February 1995. ECHR ratified 1997-06-27. ECtHR judgments binding. No direct AKN scope impact on domestic legislation.
NATO member since 29 March 2004. No direct AKN scope impact.

display.note: Latvian headings use sentence case. Likumi.lv renders nodaļa headings in bold above the pants group. Pants number rendered as Arabic ordinal with period: '5. pants'. § symbol is informal; use 'pants' in all display.

dala_disambiguation.description: The word 'daļa' appears at two structural levels. Rule-based disambiguation:

rules.condition: Element has a titled heading (e.g., 'Pirmā daļa — Ģimenes tiesības') and contains nodaļa children
rules.note: Top-level Part in large codes (Civillikums, Komerclikums). Ordinal Latvian label: 'Pirmā daļa', 'Otrā daļa'. Only present in codes with 200+ pants.

rules.condition: Element is a numbered inline subdivision of a pants — preceded by '(1)', '(2)' pattern and contains prose text, not titled heading
rules.note: Paragraph subdivision of pants. Numbered (1), (2). No heading. Most common usage — occurs in virtually every Latvian act.

dala_disambiguation.fallback: If ambiguous, inspect parent element: if parent is 'likums' body root, classify as part; if parent is 'pants', classify as paragraph.

validation.note: Public reference profile; synthetic XML controls do not certify corpus coverage.
